Codex Engineering Assignment: Evidence-Grounded Historical Reconstruction

Your task is to improve the actual repository and produce reproducible evidence of the improvement, not merely write an assessment, proposal, or favorable benchmark report.

Complete as much of the actual engineering work as the available environment permits.

Start by inspecting the repository and establishing the baseline.

Then implement the highest-impact improvements.

Do not stop at a plan. Do not merely add documentation or a benchmark that awards credit for candidate relationships.

Prioritize real, verifiable historical reconstruction and preserve the existing integrity-first design.

The final objective is a system whose capabilities can be established through independently reproducible original-source experiments, not through assertions about what it should be able to do.

How can we fix this The familiar-record replay still has no supported answers, and the broader reconstruction objective remains unproven.

How can we improve  close the supported-answer gap
scope: Inspect actual baseline architecture, strict support, eligibility, event candidates, corrections, investigation and inverse mapping before implementation; preserve frozen inputs and reports.

Repair ordinary-prose shared conditional/negative scope, report/request complements, full passive agent spans and explicit referenced-document versus receipt/publication/revision date cues. Keep inferred actors/events and historical truth unresolved.
Add 24 adversarial tests, candidate/abstain report fields and a hash-checked original-record comparison/audit tool with blank two-reviewer/adjudication packets.
Retain all failed, canceled and intermediate attempts, original-source errors, final baseline comparisons, exact source examples, query/audit costs and prospective unseen-review protocol.

Diagnose the supported-answer gap explicitly: strict support lacks atomic documentary claim verification and compound answer composition. This update does not implement that layer or demonstrate native supported-answer gains.
validation: Clean baseline 38e273855e577cff038f704c63fe09b22ac6889a: 1011 tests passed in 629.069 seconds.
Final c6f77bef76a90219ae6e2074f0302fa3d72ada19 extracted source archive: 1035 tests passed in 485.354 seconds; 54 focused tests passed in 4.008 seconds.

Final public prepared evidence 52/52, with zero observed false supported bridges in that suite. Original-paper replay: four pinned originals, 31 verified documentary observations, six traversed declared relations, 15 unresolved relations; answer support and historical truth false.

Final archive infrastructure/documentation/handoff, UI/transport/JavaScript API/helper/model-loader/WebGPU contracts, crawler fixtures, real pinned WebAssembly, and fresh Chromium published baseline/local candidate checks passed. No deployment performed.

All 14 original and eight familiar-government-record final cases completed without timeouts. Draft span coverage unchanged at 18/23 and 9/9; native supported answers remain 0/14 and 0/8. Source-linked partial findings are not scored as verified historical relationships.
All 641 final rich finding appearances passed exact original-byte mapping and non-authority checks. This establishes fidelity, not semantic correctness or independent historical truth.

All 1445 previously frozen historical-family files byte-identical to baseline after final tests; existing tests, frozen harness, importer, sources, questions, draft expectations and prior reports unchanged.

Retained invalid initial pre-edit-launch full-suite log, 22 namespace-blocked worker attempts, five canceled superseded jobs, phase checkpoints and corrected development failures (false infinitive governor, truncated honorific agent, receipt/date confusion).

The comparison tool rejects tampered outputs; an unchanged run self-comparison produces no changed interpretations. Query CPU/wall/RSS/logical source reads and separately bounded audit costs retained; unknown semantic/human metrics remain null.
limitations: The primary native historical supported-answer objective remains unmet. Better source-linked candidate fields are not supported relationships.
Independent human review, adjudication and genuinely unseen evaluation NOT RUN. No simulated reviewers or independent accuracy scores.

Finite grammar remains fallible; aliases, pronouns, distant scope, indirect attribution, OCR, event co-reference, partial correction scope, missing intermediates and causal/priority claims remain unresolved. Five incomplete-draft reference spans are still missing.
Original/familiar sources were inspected during development; final repair is not independently unseen. Human effort and semantic error rates remain unknown.

Jobs overlapped under differing host load. Recorded costs do not establish an efficiency improvement. Reverse mapping reparses originals repeatedly and can take minutes; audit source read bytes were not instrumented.

No push, merge, deployment, production-readiness, general historical understanding or scientific validation claim. The tested implementation is c6f77be; subsequent commit contains evidence and coordination updates with identical runtime source/tests/tools.
next_steps: Implement separately checked atomic documentary evidence obligations and support verification while retaining full original-question delivery exclusions and exact source/qualifier/date/identity/conflict checks.
Compose verified partial claims; require all question obligations before top-level supported_answer. Keep extraction/model judgments advisory and historical truth separate.

Freeze the implementation before an independent custodian supplies new hash-pinned originals, independently authored questions and sealed expected graphs; obtain two actual human reviews and adjudication before semantic accuracy claims.
